title: eruca arvensis
intro: Eruca arvensis, commonly known as garden rocket or land cress, is a cool-season annual crop in the Brassicaceae family. It has been used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Eruca arvensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as arthritis, bronchitis, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Eruca arvensis include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
